captions: Claude. Codex. Cursor. Copilot. You pay for all of them.
Each one resets on its own clock, in its own dashboard.
Headroom puts them all on one screen.
Each account gets a panel: its session and weekly limits, credits and banked resets, with a countdown to the next reset.
Detailed sorts every account by how close it is to its limit.
Compare names the one to use next.
Timeline shows when your headroom comes back.
Wallet adds up what it all costs, in one currency.
Get a warning on Telegram or by webhook before you run out.
Automations use a banked Codex reset, log top-ups and watch your budgets.
And Privacy Mode blurs emails when you share your screen.
There's no hosted version, on purpose. Your logins stay encrypted on your own server.
Run it on your own server. It's free and open source. Try the live demo at headroom.theblank.club.
